notes:
Account summary: SMB e-commerce SaaS offering B2C returns/fulfillment chat widget. Early discovery — converted from self-serve trial to talk to AE after seeing rate limiting in logs. Wants hosted API (public cloud) — priority is predictable availability during marketing flashes (hour-long traffic spikes) and low ops overhead.

Traffic profile / requirements: target steady-state 5-10 RPS, expected peak bursts up to 80-100 concurrent reqs during promotional windows, monthly token budget ~15-25M, want 95th pct latency <300ms for short responses. Cost sensitive; prefers clear per-token billing and automatic graceful degradation policies instead of building custom queuing.

Technical concerns raised: "We saw 429s in our POC at ~60 concurrent calls — users get angry during peak hours." Wants guidance on concurrency limits, recommended backoff (exponential jitter), and burst allowances. Also asked about per-key quotas, the relationship between per-route concurrency and tenant burst, and how to surface metric alerts for 429 spikes.

Security/compliance: requires SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs retention for 90 days, and SOC2 info for procurement packet. Not interested in private deployment at this stage.

Sales/eng notes: Offer quickstart: 1) temporary increased burst quota for 3-day sales test, 2) sample backoff middleware (JS/Python), 3) dashboard alert template (429 rate threshold + token burn rate). Follow-up tech sync to align on test window and quotas.

Quoted blockers: limited budget window (end of Q2), needs procurement sign-off, needs explicit SLA language for burst handling before committing to paid tier.
customer_pitch: Hosted API winner: self-serve onboarding + clear burst policy. Emphasize 3-day trial burst allowance, backoff best-practices, and observability templates to reduce false-positive 429s and speed up procurement.
